notes: Employees: year-end count for fiscal 2026, including part-time employees (the 10-K says Costco targets at least 50% full-time and also uses seasonal employees). Payroll: the 10-K says compensation and benefits are its largest expense after merchandise but gives no total, so the CEO pay ratio median is used. It comes from the proxy filed December 4, 2025 and covers fiscal 2025 (median identified on June 30, 2025 from about 323,800 full-time, part-time, seasonal and temporary employees; ratio 283:1), a year behind the head count; the proxy for fiscal 2026 was not yet filed.
